report.summary: tests/test_council_vendors.py: Offline tests for the cross-vendor council adapters, verifying no network calls, secret floor enforcement, prompt isolation, and structural constraints.
risks: CLAIMS|tests/test_council_vendors.py|Offline tests with no network, no Ollama, no vendor CLI: every transport is injected.
